source_reviewed_activity_groups.group: Supplementary Table S2 protease MIC rows
source_reviewed_activity_groups.endpoint: MIC against E. coli O157:H7 with digestive protease conditions
source_reviewed_activity_groups.condition_caution: Some DBAASP note fields collapse multiple same-valued protease conditions into one row or use ambiguous spelling. Preserve the packet row note, but use Table S2 as the primary condition locator.

source_reviewed_activity_groups.group: Graph-derived hemolysis and cytotoxicity DBAASP rows
units: no unit for percent effect values
source_locators: paper.xml lines 237-250; Figure 2 caption and biosafety text
source_reviewed_activity_groups.reason: The packet has primary figure locators for hemolysis/cytotoxicity context and DBAASP rows preserve raw percent-effect values and concentrations, but the exact plotted percent values for every row are not text-readable from the available packet extraction. These rows should not be promoted to source_verified unless worker-6 or an activity stage verifies the figure-level values directly.

related_other_literature_rows_policy.reason: Rows linked to the same DBAASP sequences but other PubMed IDs are related database evidence, not current-paper primary-source evidence for DOI 10.1002/advs.202205301.

adjudication_note: All retained activity/toxicity rows preserve endpoint, raw value, unit or no-unit rationale through curation notes, target, assay conditions, and source locator. No database-only row was promoted without primary-source context.
